title: Quentin and the Postcards
author: Jude Delacroix
blurb: Wendell Thornbury, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
